role: external evaluation only, French zero-shot, no additional split or fit
retrieval_corpus: Every released CGI version, not only benchmark gold articles; remaining five released codes retained as raw source
date_selection: date_debut <= date_anchor and (date_fin is null or date_anchor <= date_fin); exclude MODIFIE_MORT_NE; prefer latest start then latest end NULL first
static_selection: official VIGUEUR excluding VIGUEUR_DIFF, else date-applicable at frozen static_snapshot_date
history_eligibility: date_debut <= date_anchor; no future effective version

bm25.tokenization: NFKC then NFKD accent removal, lowercase ASCII word/number tokens
bm25.idf: fixed full-CGI chunk bank across all dates

retrieval_instruction: Given a French tax-law question, retrieve French legal provisions that answer the question
reranker_document: Discovered chunk for direct baselines; dense-best dated chunk of the bound version for bound methods; no gold
reader_decode: greedy, do_sample=false, fixed original HiDate Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
reader_prompt: unmodified official SYSTEM and build_user_prompt; official query-window body then fixed4096-token packing
frozen_japanese_transfer: Reuse completed Japanese TRAIN weights and Japanese VALID alpha/thresholds with no French fit, retuning, threshold selection, prompt selection, or seed sweep
feature_adaptation: Same ten HiDate features. Law-scoped address becomes stable CGI article CID; revision becomes released version ID; latest historical captured anchor gap becomes latest historical effective-start gap
answer_scoring: Direct official score_nuggets.normalize/parse_numbers/match_nugget, provenance excluded from text coverage, required nuggets for strict
citation_scoring: official article-number nugget, emitted version-ID presence, top1 retrieval identity and article/version recall among actual packed reader evidence; report distinctly
references: closed_book and gold-CID oracle_asof; proprietary C-prod is not implemented or reproduced
canary: Skip _CANARY_ and all nonR3 records; no benchmark content enters training
